# opnsense_dhcrelay_destination (Data Source)

DHCP servers that relayed requests are forwarded to (**Services ▸ DHCP Relay ▸ Destinations**).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the DHCP relay destination.

### Read-Only
